{{Quote|Oh, come on, Chewie. We've gotten into more heavily guarded places than that—''"<br />"''Frowh rahgh rahrahraff vrawgh gr.''"<br />"''Well, the spice vaults of Gargon, for one.|Han Solo and Chewbacca|<ref name="ROTJn" />}}
The [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] mounted a '''heist''' to steal valuable [[Spice/Legends|spice]]<ref name="CSWE" /> from the [[Spice vaults of Gargon|spice vaults]]<ref name="ROTJn" /> of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gargon/Legends|Gargon]] some [[Time/Legends|time]] prior to joining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in their [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|struggle]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="CSWE" /> Although those vaults were owned by a notorious [[Unidentified gangster (Gargon)|gangster]]<ref name="AGTSWU2" /> and heavily guarded,<ref name="ROTJn" /> Solo and Chewbacca managed to break in, and they stole a hoard of spice stored there. As a result of their successful theft, the smugglers received double [[Currency/Legends|payment]].<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, Solo and Chewbacca were sent on a mission to the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]] as members of the Rebel Alliance. They were part of a [[Endor strike team/Legends|strike team]] tasked with breaking into an [[Endor shield generator bunker|Imperial bunker]], which Solo likened to his past heist on Gargon.<ref name="ROTJn" />
